title: Director
description:
Key Account - O&G Buscamos profissionais que incorporem nossos valores, não têm medo de desafios, busquem inovar, experimentar e se aprimorar rapidamente. Nosso objetivo é contratar e reter os indivíduos mais brilhantes, oferecendo crescimento profissional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento em toda a carreira. Se é você, adoraríamos conversar. Sobre o papel Estamos em busca de um Key Account na área de Óleo e Gás para liderar a relação estratégica e impulsionar o crescimento no segmento de Óleo & Gás, atuando como principal ponto focal da conta. Essa posição será responsável por influenciar demandas e editais, identificar oportunidades ao longo da cadeia técnica e conduzir vendas consultivas complexas de serviços TIC e/ou equipamentos de alto valor agregado. Espera-se um perfil com forte bagagem técnica, capacidade de relacionamento em alto nível, poder de influência e visão estratégica, além de protagonismo na expansão de negócios tanto na Petrobras quanto em novos clientes do setor. Sobre o Grupo Bureau Veritas Fundado em 1828, somos líder mundial em serviços de testes laboratoriais, inspeção e certificação, possuímos mais de 74 mil funcionários em 1.400 escritórios e laboratórios ao redor do globo. Nossa missão é oferecer serviços e soluções inovadoras para garantir que os ativos, produtos e processos de nossos mais de 400 mil clientes atendam a padrões e regulamentos em termos de qualidade, saúde, segurança, proteção ambiental e responsabilidade social. Há 190 anos nossa marca é sinônimo de integridade e confiança, em benefício dos negócios e das pessoas, contribuindo para transformar o mundo em que vivemos. Para saber um pouco mais acesse o site Principais responsabilidades: Desenvolver e sustentar conexões de alto nível com stakeholders estratégicos (áreas técnicas, suprimentos e liderança), fortalecendo o posicionamento institucional Influenciar tecnicamente e comercialmente a construção de editais e demandas, a partir do entendimento das necessidades do cliente. Mapear oportunidades dentro da cadeia de valor de O&G, com foco em serviços TIC (Teste, Inspeção e Certificação) e soluções técnicas associadas Conduzir vendas consultivas complexas, envolvendo serviços e/ou equipamentos de alto valor agregado para aplicações em infraestrutura, embarcações e plataformas;
Atuar de forma estratégica na identificação de demandas técnicas críticas (ex.: integridade de ativos, corrosão, manutenção industrial), propondo soluções customizadas;
Gerenciar e expandir contas-chave (KAM), garantindo crescimento sustentável e aumento de participação dentro do cliente;
Desenvolver novas contas no segmento de Óleo & Gás, ampliando a presença da empresa no mercado e gerando novas frentes de receita Coordenar internamente com equipes técnicas e operacionais para construção de propostas robustas e aderentes às exigências do cliente Atuar com forte protagonismo na negociação de contratos complexos e de grande porte Acompanhar tendências regulatórias, técnicas e comerciais do setor, incluindo conhecimento aplicado em SEMPS Garantir o atingimento das metas comerciais, acompanhando indicadores de performance e pipeline de vendas O que buscamos: Experiência em posições comerciais no setor de TIC (Teste, Inspeção e Certificação), com forte atuação no segmento de Óleo & Gás;
Experiência comprovada na gestão de contas estratégicas (KAM), com foco em O&A Conhecimento aprofundado da cadeia técnica e de suprimentos, incluindo dinâmica de editais e processos comerciais Vivência com venda de serviços técnicos e equipamentos para aplicações industriais, offshore, embarcações e plataformas Background técnico, preferencialmente com formação em engenharia ou áreas correlatas Familiaridade com normas, processos e sistemas aplicáveis ao setor (ex.: SEMPS) Forte habilidade de influência, negociação e relacionamento em ambientes complexos Perfil proativo e com visão estratégica;
Capacidade detransitar entre áreas técnicas e executivas, com comunicação eficaz em múltiplos níveis;
O quenós podemos oferecer: Esta é uma ótima oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, trabalhando em uma equipe de especialistas. Nossos colaboradores são inovadores, curiosos e ambiciosos, sempre motivados e focados em novas soluções, pois, somos constantemente desafiados por uma indústria em rápida evolução que inclui um portfólio global de clientes, com milhares empresas, grandes e pequenas que confiam em nosso trabalho para melhorar seus negócios. Ao participar deste processo de recrutamento & seleção, do Bureau Veritas Brasil, o(a) candidato(a) declara: Estar em condições técnicas e operacionais, no que tange à ergonomia, estação de trabalho e velocidade de conexão internet para desempenhar, quando necessário, o trabalho remoto “home office”;
O Bureau Veritas estáem conformidade com a Constituição Federal brasileira (no inc. V do seu art. 5o.Inc. XXVIII, a, do art. 5o) bem como, a Lei nº 13.709/18, que dispõe sobre o Tratamento e Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). Sendo assim, mediante o seu consentimento com o envio de informações está em consonância com o Bureau Veritas, respeitando a Legislação supramencionada.

title: Psicopedagogo(A)
description: Buscamos um(a) psicopedagogo(a) com formação em Psicologia e pós-graduação em Psicopedagogia para integrar nossa equipe. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e aplicar estratégias psicopedagógicas focadas no aprendizado e no desenvolvimento de habilidades cognitivas, emocionais e sociais das crianças e adolescentes atendidos. RESPONSABILIDADES Realizar avaliações psicopedagógicas de crianças e adolescentes com diagnóstico de neurodiversidade (principalmente TEA). Desenvolver planos de intervenção psicopedagógica personalizados, com base nas necessidades individuais de cada paciente. Aplicar estratégias de ensino diferenciadas, trabalhando o desenvolvimento de habilidades cognitivas, acadêmicas e sociais. Acompanhar o progresso dos pacientes e ajustar as intervenções conforme necessário. Colaborar, quando necessário, com a equipe da clínica para alinhamento de condutas e informações sobre os pacientes. Orientar pais e responsáveis, fornecendo devolutivas sobre o progresso e a adaptação dos pacientes, com foco em estratégias de continuidade do tratamento em casa. Realizar relatórios periódicos de acompanhamento e evolução dos pacientes. Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo. REQUISITOS Formação em Psicologia e Pós‑graduação em Psicopedagogia. Experiência comprovada em atendimento psicopedagógico, preferencialmente com crianças e adolescentes com neurodiversidade. Desejável experiência com Terapia ABA, Intervenção precoce ou outros métodos específicos de atendimento para pacientes com TEA. Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar e boa comunicação com pais, pacientes e demais profissionais da clínica. Desejável conhecimento em práticas de inclusão escolar e estratégias de ensino diferenciadas. Proatividade, empatia e vontade de aprender constantemente sobre neurodiversidade. Informações adicionais Contrato: PJ #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Head Of Legal
description:
About InPlanet InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive;
the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here About the Role We are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets, requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process. A SANDECH foi fundada em 2008, na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, com o propósito de desenvolver projetos multidisciplinares para o setor industrial. Mais do que uma empresa de engenharia, a SANDECH se posiciona como um parceiro estratégico de seus clientes, unindo experiência técnica, inovação e qualidade. Em constante crescimento, buscamos profissionais comprometidos com a excelência e com a construção de soluções cada vez mais eficientes e sustentáveis para a indústria brasileira. title: 4501 - Gerente De Negócios Pf ( Pessoa Física ) - Rio De Janeiro
description: Descrição da vaga Faça parte de uma empresa que prioriza os relacionamentos. Valorizamos um clima leve e de muito respeito. Trabalhamos por um ambiente inclusivo e de proximidade entre todas as pessoas colaboradoras. Melhorar cada vez mais a qualidade de vida é uma busca constante por aqui. Por aqui, todo mundo trabalha lado a lado. Tudo o que fazemos é pensando no coletivo. Colocamos as pessoas no centro e no coração do nosso negócio. Nossas ações e soluções têm a estratégia focada nas pessoas. Valorizamos os nossos relacionamentos, pois é a partir deles que construímos um mundo melhor. Gerenciar a carteira e estar atento às movimentações de mercado, analisando e identificando oportunidades de negócio, gerenciando o risco e criando estratégias para prospecção, ampliando nossa participação de mercado. Realizar negócios a partir da cultura da empresa, prezando pelos valores, pelo objetivo estratégico e pela entrega do propósito. Requisitos e qualificações Graduação completa Certificação CPA-10 Experiência na área comercial em Instituições Financeiras Conhecimento em matemática financeira Disponibilidade para estabelecer relacionamento com o público de atuação Conhecimento de produtos e serviços financeiros Informações adicionais VT + Pacote de Benefícios: VR + VA + A.Médica Alfa Titular 100% + A. Odontológica + Previdência Privada + Seguro de Vida + Auxílio Creche até 6 anos de idade + Auxílio Creche Filho com deficiência + Sempre Bem (assistência profissional, assistência psicológica, jurídica e financeira) + Incentivo à formação profissional + PPR anual + educação corporativa online e presencial + Gympass + Telemedicina + Desconto Farmácia. Etapas do processo Cadastro Análise de Currículos Teste de Perfil - PDA Entrevista individual com Gestão de Pessoas Entrevista com Gestor Contratação Somos o Sicredi, a primeira Instituição Financeira Cooperativa do Brasil. Muito prazer, nós somos o Sicredi. Nossa trajetória começou há mais de 120 anos, como a primeira instituição financeira cooperativa do Brasil. Hoje, seguimos crescendo e nos transformando a cada dia, ao lado de mais de 50 mil pessoas colaboradoras. São elas que nos tornam a Melhor Empresa Para Trabalhar, ocupando novamente a primeira posição, segundo o Great Place To Work Brasil (GPTW). Junto a mais de 9 milhões de associados, em todos os estados do país, acreditamos no poder da cooperação para construir uma sociedade mais próspera e gerar impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Um propósito que nos une e nos inspira, promovendo o desenvolvimento local e sustentável, a educação e a inclusão financeira. Seguimos buscando talentos que queiram fazer parte da construção de um mundo melhor e queremos contar com você. #VemSerSicredi! #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Ai Engineer Id59360
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE As a Middle Backend Engineer, you’ll build the infrastructure that lets AI agents read, reason, and act on real energy data — connecting LLMs, APIs, and live data sources into production systems that run 24/7. High ownership, early stage, genuinely hard domain problem. If you want to build AI-native systems from the ground up with direct product impact, this is for you. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build production backend systems connecting LLMs and coding agents with data and product APIs;
Design and deploy microservices using Python and optionally TypeScript;
Develop data connectors to external portals and public data sources;
Design backend infrastructure enabling AI agents to operate across data systems;
Ensure performance, scalability, and reliability of backend systems;
Implement observability and CI/CD pipelines for monitoring and maintenance;
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business problems into technical solutions. MUST HAVES 2+ years of experience building backend systems using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI ;
Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ;
Experience owning backend services end-to-end (APIs, integrations, deployments, monitoring);
Strong skillsin debugging and problem-solving ;
Experience working with LLMs and AI tools (LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar);
Ability to rapidly prototype and iterate solutions;
Ability to work independently and manage priorities;
Strong communication skills across technical and business stakeholders;
Comfort working in fast-paced environments;
NICE TO HAVES Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform);
Experience inenergy, fintech, or automation domains;
Experience with AWS. PERKS AND BENEFITS Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps. Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets. Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies. Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Consultor
description:
Descrição da vagaSomos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!Buscamos um(a) consultor(a) SAP Basis & Security para atuar na gestão e evolução do ambiente SAP, com foco em governança de acessos (roles/perfis), conformidade de licenças SAP por FUE, segurança do landscape, gestão operacional do SAP HANA, além de rotinas de capacidade e armazenamento.Responsabilidades e atribuições- Administrar SAP Security (perfis/roles/autorizações): criação, manutenção, revisões e troubleshooting;
- Conduzir a gestão de acessos ponta a ponta (concessão, alteração e revogação), garantindo trilha de auditoria e aderência às boas práticas de governança;
- Assegurar o controle ea conformidade de licenças SAP por FUE, acompanhando consumo, classificação e oportunidades de otimização;
- Atuar em SAP Basis: monitoramento, disponibilidade, performance, troubleshooting e rotinas operacionais;
- Operar e manter o SAP HANA (administração e rotinas operacionais), com atenção à performance e à capacidade;
- Realizar a gestão de espaço em disco e atuar preventivamente para evitar indisponibilidades (limpeza de logs, arquivos temporários, estratégia de crescimento e alertas);
- Reforçar a segurança do ambiente SAP (parâmetros, correções e boas práticas) e apoiar demandas de compliance/auditoria;
- Suportar o SolMan (monitoramento, jobs, integrações e rotinas operacionais).Requisitos e qualificações- Experiência sólida em SAP Security (PFCG, SU01 e conceitos de autorização);
- Vivência consistente em governança de acessos, controles, rastreabilidade e atendimento a auditorias;
- Experiência com licenciamento SAP (FUE) e controle de consumo/conformidade;
- Atuação consistente emsustentação e monitoramento de ambientes SAP;
- Experiência prática com SAP HANA (rotinas de administração e operação);
- Conhecimento em gestãode espaço em disco/capacidade e ações preventivas;
- Vivência com SAP Solution Manager (SolMan).#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: ANALISTA II DE SERVIÇOS
description:
Descrição

Missão do cargo

Atuar na implantação, parametrização e suporte dos módulos Backoffice do ERP TOTVS Protheus, com foco em Controladoria, garantindo aderência aos processos de negócio, conformidade fiscal/contábil, qualidade da informação gerencial e eficiência operacional dos clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

Conduzir projetos de implantação do Protheus Backoffice, Levantar e mapear processos do cliente (AS-IS / TO-BE), Parametrizar módulos do sistema conforme regras de negócio. Implantar e integrar módulos como: Configurador de Tributos, Contabilidade (CTB), Ativo Fixo (ATF), Fiscal (SIGAFIS), Financeiro (SIGAFIN), Compras (SIGACOM), Faturamento (SIGAFAT), Estoque/Custos (SIGAEST / SIGACST). Configurar plano de contas, centros de custo, rateios, estruturas contábeis e gerenciais. Implantar rotinas de controladoria e gestão de resultados. Validar integrações fiscais, contábeis e financeiras, Executar testes integrados e homologações.  Treinar usuários finais e equipes do cliente.  Elaborar documentação técnica e funcional. Atuar no suporte pós-implantação. Apoiar clientes em melhorias de processos e uso do ERP. Interface com áreas técnicas (TI, desenvolvimento, banco de dados)

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação Obrigatória: Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Produção, Economia, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas. Conhecimentos Técnicos Necessários:  Protheus – Parametrização dos módulos Backoffice, Conhecimento de tabelas, dicionário de dados e ambiente Protheus, Configurações de ambientes, empresas, filiais, usuários e perfis, Integrações entre módulos, Rotinas fiscais, contábeis e financeiras. Controladoria – Contabilidade gerencial, Centros de custo e unidades de negócio, Estrutura de resultados (DRE gerencial), Orçamento empresarial, Rateios e alocações, Apuração de resultados, Custos (direto, indireto, fixo, variável), Indicadores financeiros e gerenciais. Fiscal/Contábil – SPED Contábil e Fiscal, ICMS, IPI, ISS, PIS/COFINS, Regimes tributários, Escrituração fiscal e contábil, Obrigações acessórias.

title: ANALISTA II DE SERVIÇOS
description:
Descrição

Buscamos um(a) Analista Protheus com experiência em implantação, migração e suporte funcional/técnico para atuar nos principais módulos do sistema TOTVS Protheus. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a estabilidade, performance e aderência do sistema às necessidades das áreas de negócio, contribuindo diretamente para a eficiência dos processos corporativos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

Realizar implantação, migração e suporte das versões recentes do Protheus TOTVS, assegurando o funcionamento adequado dos módulos e integrações; Atuar tecnicamente junto aos usuários e equipes internas, prestando suporte remoto e presencial; Efetuar o levantamento e desenho de requisitos de negócio relacionados à área de Controladoria; Analisar e resolver incidentes de forma ágil e crítica, garantindo a continuidade dos processos operacionais; Criar e ajustar sintaxes em ADVPL para Lançamentos Padronizados e CNABs; Garantir o alinhamento entre as demandas funcionais e as configurações técnicas do sistema.

Requisitos e qualificações

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Tecnologia da Informação, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas; Experiência comprovada com implantação, migração e suporte do Protheus TOTVS nos módulos de Gestão Fiscal, Financeiro, Contabilidade e Ativo Fixo; Conhecimento em parametrizações, rotinas, integrações e funcionalidades dos módulos citados; Experiência em ADVPL.

The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!

  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state‑of‑the‑art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team.   • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter‑service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS
  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture

  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies

  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences
  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services
  • Participate in on‑call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs
We Are Looking For a Person Who Has
  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large‑scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object‑oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations
  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD
  • Good communication skills to prevent risks and explain trade‑offs clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders

title: Senior Product Manager - Mode (Remote)
description:
About Mode Mobile

Mode Mobile is the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users globally to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, shopping, etc., turning users into earners and, eventually, owners through stock ownership based on usage. The company has facilitated over $150M in earnings and savings for more than 40 million users across 170 countries.

Team & Culture

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, curiosity, and a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster open communication and transparency. Our culture is driven by OKRs, positive intent, ownership, and a commitment to high standards.

For more details on how we work, you can read further at our internal resources.

The Role

Mode Mobile is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for a recently acquired multimillion‑dollar utility app. Over time, the role will expand to encompass newly acquired and organically developed mobile applications. This senior‑level, high‑ownership role requires a proven product leader with business acumen, operational excellence, and user empathy.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and lead a vision for your products that aligns with organizational goals
  • Develop strategic product‑feature roadmaps and drive execution from concept to scale by analyzing and implementing best‑in‑market trends and out‑of‑the‑box ideas
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, User Acquisition, Monetization, and Data teams to deliver value‑driven, measurable results
  • Own business and product performance, including revenue, engagement, conversion, retention, and P&L outcomes, and financial forecasts
  • Conduct ongoing experimentation, user and competitor research to support strategic decision making that drives monetization and user growth
  • Provide visibility into business performance and communicate results clearly to executive stakeholders and the broader organization
  • Serve as a role model and standard‑setter for product excellence for your cross‑function team
Who You Are
  • A strategic, business‑minded product leader with deep understanding of P&L ownership and revenue drivers
  • A self‑starter who thrives in ambiguity and operates with high accountability in driving efficient product pipelines
  • Experienced leading product dev teams to drive engagement and impact on the product and business
  • Expert at balancing user value with business impact, ensuring that both scale together
  • Skilled at using data, A/B experimentation, and intuition to make the best possible decisions
  • A natural collaborator who communicates effectively across all levels of the organization
  • Alignment with our core values
  • Accountable: Take ownership of responsibilities, demonstrate trustworthiness, and consistently follow through on commitments
  • Action‑driven: Identify priorities, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact
  • Caring: Genuinely care about people, the business, and the mission, and strive to create a positive, supportive environment
  • Curious: Focus on the "why," learn, expand knowledge, explore new ideas, and continually improve
  • Thorough: Deliver thoughtful, accurate, and complete work with meticulous attention to detail
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of professional product management experience, including 3+ years of independently owning a product or business line
  • Proven experience managing products with P&L accountability and delivering measurable business outcomes
  • Experience in mobile app ecosystems, with strong understanding of subscription, IAP, and IAA monetization strategies (utility, rewarded, social, or gaming apps is a plus)
  • Demonstrated success within multi‑app portfolios
  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in data tools such as Mixpanel, Google Sheets, and business performance dashboards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of influencing at the executive level
Why This Role Matters

This is a high‑impact role where you will be the ringleader for one of Mode's most successful mobile apps, driving millions of users and ~$10 M / yr in revenue. Your success can help create blueprints for aggressive expansion through in‑house products and M&A, opening opportunities across the portfolio.

Workplace Norms
  • Allow OKRs to guide us
  • Assume positive intent
  • Agree to disagree & commit
  • Set new precedents
  • Accomplish more with less
  • Hold yourself & others to high standards
  • Speak up
  • Be resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 rule
What We Are Offering
  • 100% remote‑first, global company
  • A competitive compensation package
  • Generous perks & benefits
  • Participation in the company equity and token plan (full‑time)
  • Individual bonuses in accordance with our bonus program
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people
  • Celebrate personal & work milestones
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies
  • Recognition via Bonusly
  • Weekly Wednesday "Get Stuff Done Days" (no meetings)
  • Open PTO and generous company holidays
  • 10 annual Wellness Fridays
Next Steps

If we just described the role you want and your ideal team, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to creating success together!

Equal Employment Opportunity

Mode Mobile does not accept or pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third‑party agencies/vendors. Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: MEDICO CLINICO SAE - AP 1.0
description:
SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrófica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Efetuar exames médicos, emitir diagnósticos, prescrever medicamentos, realizar outras formas de tratamento; tirar dúvidas e orientar pacientes em situações que requerem mais atenção.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função.
Informações adicionais
  • Carga Horária: 24 horas semanais;

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
Job Description

The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:
  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets.
What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required.
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred.
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector.
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required.
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios.
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility.
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes.
Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever‑present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Overview

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Supervisionar e coordenar equipes de manutenção mecânica, assegurando a execução segura e eficiente das atividades corretivas, preventivas e preditivas.

  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente (SMS), procedimentos corporativos e regulamentações aplicáveis ao ambiente offshore.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória: experiência comprovada em supervisão de manutenção mecânica em ambiente offshore.
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos, guindastes e equipamentos rotativos de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento obrigatório em sistemas de gestão da manutenção e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).
  • Experiência com equipamentos de perfuração e/ou turbinas (gás ou vapor) será considerada um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas, boas práticas de manutenção e requisitos regulatórios do setor de óleo e gás.
Informações adicionais
  • Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO? Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura.
  • Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas.
  • Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado.
  • Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o gestor da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.
  • Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO
  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista. Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, então não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo! Venha fazer parte da PRIO.

Sobre a PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único. Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Ambiente de trabalho

description:
Head of Commercial Partnerships

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (”FWWC”).

The Head of Commercial Partnerships has responsibility, under the leadership of FIFA’s Director Commercial Partnerships and the operational guidance of the Brazil Entity Chief Operations Officers, for the successful implementation and coordination of the commercial revenue programs for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

This cross-functional position plays a critical role in planning, managing and implementing Host Country commercial revenues activities related to sponsorship sales, partnership management & partner rights delivery and commercial operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • In close cooperation with FIFA’s Commercial Partnerships department, manage the day-to-day implementation plans in relation to the Tournament’s commercial partnerships programs, as well as manage relevant local sales agencies and service providers.
  • Working with Relevant Department Heads from FIFA, lead the Host Country commercial partnerships staff across sponsorship sales, partnership management and partner rights delivery.
  • Work with FIFA Commercial Partnerships Sub-Division and Host Country to shape integrated plans and strategies, including relevant sales and operational plans.
  • Working closely with the FIFA Partnership Sales team, ensure the effective delivery of the Tournament’s sponsorship sales with a focus on regional sponsorships in host country.
  • Identify and develop strong relationships with potential key sponsors and agencies in the host country and wider region, proactively lead on contract negotiations, and contribute to maintaining strong and effective relationships with sponsors.
  • Manage the regional sponsorship sales process in accordance with the defined timetable and priorities and negotiate agreements across relevant markets.
  • In close alignment with FIFA Partnership Management team, contribute to building strong and successful relationships with FIFA partners.
  • Working closely with FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and with the support of a local team, deliver all commercial operations as per the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition-related events and sites.
  • In close collaboration with the FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and Brazil, ensure successful implementation of the public Food & Beverage (F&B) concessions programme across all stadiums.
  • Manage and support a talented team of individuals, located at Brazil HQ across all commercial partnerships and licensing projects.
YOUR PROFILE
  • 10+ years of international commercial experience in sport
  • Proven experience within global sports / Rights Holder environment
  • Proven track record managing major commercial programs across sponsorship sales, partnership management and commercial operations
  • Proven and successful track record in opening, negotiating and closing significant multi-year, multi-million sponsorship deals
  • Knowledge of commercial operations in major event settings and/or the sports industry
  • Experienced negotiator and ability to manage complex and lengthy processes
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across multiple teams and at varying levels
  • Experience and knowledge of local markets and culture
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain qualified employees
  • Experience of managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement
  • Creative and strategic thinker from a diverse background
  • Proficient in preparing and managing budgets
  • Proven organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly under pressure
  • Solid operational and strategic marketing knowledge/experience
  • Operational knowledge and experience in major international events, preferably sports events
  • Passion for sport

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us! Chief of Staff

The Chief of Staff serves as the Dean’s senior strategic advisor and operational partner, providing executive-level leadership support, institutional coordination, and oversight of school-wide strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for translating the Dean’s vision into actionable priorities, ensuring alignment across academic, administrative, and operational functions, and supporting decision‑making at the highest level of the School.

This position is designed as a future‑state leadership role focused on strategy, governance, and executive coordination. It does not manage day‑to‑day program execution, event planning, or operational delivery functions, which are carried out within academic and administrative units.

The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Dean of the School of Communications.

Supervisory Authority

The Chief of Staff may provide functional and strategic oversight of administrative staff or project teams as assigned by the Dean. Supervisory authority, when delegated, is focused on initiative coordination, performance alignment, and accountability, rather than day‑to‑day task supervision. This role does not supervise academic programs.

Nature and Scope

The Chief of Staff operates at the executive level within the School of Communications and supports the Dean through strategic coordination, leadership advising, and institutional alignment. The role requires independent judgment, discretion, and a high level of professional integrity. The scope of the position is strategic and advisory, rather than programmatic or operational.

Key Responsibilities Executive Strategy & Leadership Support
  • Serve as the Dean’s principal strategic advisor on institutional priorities, organizational effectiveness, and operational planning.
  • Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of school‑wide strategic initiatives and long‑range goals.
  • Prepare executive‑level briefings, analyses, and recommendations to support informed decision‑making.
Institutional Coordination & Governance
  • Coordinate cross‑functional efforts among academic leadership, administrative units, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with the School’s mission and objectives.
  • Represent the Dean, as appropriate, in senior‑level meetings, working groups, and institutional forums.
  • Monitor progress on key initiatives and elevate risks, dependencies, and decision points to the Dean.
Operational Oversight (Strategic Level)
  • Provide high‑level oversight of administrative and operational workflows to ensure efficiency, accountability, and alignment with institutional standards.
  • Partner with senior administrators to identify opportunities for process improvement and organizational alignment.
  • Support clarity in leadership roles, responsibilities, and decision‑making authority.
Communications & Special Projects
  • Lead or support high‑priority initiatives and special projects at the direction of the Dean.
  • Draft, review, and coordinate executive communications, reports, and institutional correspondence.
  • Ensure consistency and clarity in messaging across leadership initiatives.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic leadership and sound judgment
  • Executive‑level written and verbal communication
  • Organizational effectiveness and process improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship management
  • Analytical thinking and problem‑solving
  • Project and initiative oversight
  • Professional discretion and integrity
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred or Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible and relevant work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in executive‑level administration, strategic planning, or institutional leadership.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast‑paced academic environments.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Nossa missão é fortalecer os pequenos varejistas como os maiores protagonistas do comércio na América Latina.

A gente acredita que por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para estes produtos.

  • Desenvolvemos um time fora da curva;
  • Não temos medo de errar, desde que isso nos ensine alguma coisa;

  • Tratamos adultos como adultos, com autonomia e responsabilidade;

Num contexto de forte crescimento das vendas, gerenciar nossa frota agregada, assegurando profissionalismo, eficiência e disponibilidade dos motoristas.

A área de transporte tem um papel essencial dentro da Clubbi, impactando a experiência dos nossos clientes no momento da entrega, e garantindo nosso crescimento por meio da captação e desenvolvimento de novos motoristas.

title: Marketing Project Leader - Life Sciences
description:
Ready to leverage your scientific expertise to contribute to the growth and visibility of a global leader in preclinical research?

QIMA Life Sciences is looking for a Marketing Project Leader – Brazil to join our Marketing team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the B2B communication and marketing strategy targeting pharma and biotech sponsors, positioning our services as key partners in analytical and clinical development for both branded and generic drugs on the Brazilian and international markets.

We are seeking a scientifically driven professional, eager to grow into a strategic role at the crossroads of marketing, scientific communication, and business development.

Reporting to the Marketing & Communication Director, Life Sciences, you will be the marketing and scientific lead for Brazil. You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and R&D teams, as well as with external partners (agencies, designers, freelancers).

Responsibilities
  • Develop and manage your area: define the marketing strategy with the Marketing Director, Managing Director Brazil, and Heads of Pharma and Cosmetics; plan, implement, and monitor marketing actions and performance.
  • Create scientific and marketing content: translate regulatory and technical information into clear, engaging messages (ICH‑GCP, ANVISA, BE, biosimilars); ensure compliance with local regulations; prepare presentations, technical sheets, brochures, white papers, and scientific articles.
  • Scientific communication: make complex data accessible to varied audiences (sales, clients, conferences).
  • Support the sales team: develop sales tools, training materials, and presentations.
  • Inbound marketing: manage web pages (PT/EN), write SEO‑optimized articles, produce newsletters and email campaigns, and contribute to lead generation.
  • Measure ROI: track campaign results and lead conversions with the sales team.
  • Event organization: coordinate participation in conferences and trade shows; build a network of KOLs and strategic partners.
Qualifications
  • MSc (or higher) in Life Sciences (Pharmacy, Biology, Biotechnology, Chemistry); PhD is a plus.
  • 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B marketing/communication within pharma, biotech, medtech, or CRO sectors.
  • Strong understanding of the drug development process and clinical research.
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, and Spanish required.
  • Proficiency in content creation and B2B CRM tools; knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and regulatory awareness.
Desired Profile
  • Autonomous and proactive, capable of driving a market segment.
  • Rigorous and results‑oriented, with strong organizational skills.
  • Creative and forward‑thinking.
  • Curious about scientific and market trends.
  • A strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Motivated by innovation and growth in an international environment.

Workplace Type: Hybrid

SOBRE O ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Assim, somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Por isso, prioriza medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, em especial para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é dar doações para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão
  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

title: Online Pre-IGCSE Science
description:
Want to revolutionize the future of education and do meaningful work that transforms future generations’ lives? Our team is looking to bring on passionate educators to support our growing student base through part‑time teaching roles. This position offers the opportunity to teach bright, motivated students from around the world while maintaining flexibility in your schedule. You'll play a key role in delivering high‑quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally.

Must be available to teach 1 or 2 hours per week on a Wednesday 1pm – 6pm AEST (Brisbane timezone).

Must be available to teach in the Australian/ New Zealand timezone, we have a lot of demand for this space so hours can be flexible.

Job Summary

Join our global team as an online teacher for Pre‑IGCSE Science and immerse yourself in a premium one‑on‑one teaching environment. This flexible, remote role empowers you to create tailored learning experiences that meet each student's unique needs, all from the comfort of your own home and on a schedule that fits your lifestyle. With full access to our comprehensive teaching resources, you'll deliver Pre‑IGCSE Level curricula, making a meaningful impact on students' educational journeys while enjoying the balance and freedom of remote teaching.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver personalized, high‑quality instruction in a one‑on‑one virtual setting, adapting to each student's unique learning needs.
  • Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment.
  • Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes.
  • Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines.
  • Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience.
  • Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth.
  • Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA’s rich resource library.
  • Efficiently manage your online classroom on Canvas, keeping it organized with assignments and assessments for easy student access.
Required Qualifications
  • A minimum of 5 years of teaching at this level in a school setting.
  • Please note, while valuable, we are unable to count tutoring experience towards this requirement.
  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in the subject area you will be teaching.
  • Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods.
  • Knowledge of the Cambridge, Edexcel or A‑Levels curricula and examinations.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Teaching qualification such as postgraduate certificate in education, degree in teaching, teaching license.
  • Online teaching experience.
About Crimson Global Academy

CGA is a world‑class online school delivering live, real‑time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students' limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures.

We Are Doing This By
  • Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age.
  • Fostering a global community that broadens students' perspectives and develops their skills to make a difference on the world stage.
  • Providing cutting‑edge technology for teachers to launch students into their future while giving parents transparency into their child’s education.

If you’re passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one‑on‑one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning, apply now! To learn more about our innovative approach, check out our newsletters and inspiring student success stories.

title: Vice President, Auditor
description:
Vice President, Auditor – Internal Audit

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting‑edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Auditor to join our Internal Audit team. This role is located in Rio de Janeiro.

Responsibilities
  • Participating in risk‑based audits covering Fund Administration, Custody, and Corporate Functions, from end‑to‑end planning through reporting, in line with Internal Audit methodologies and standards.
  • Executing thorough and accurate testing to assess adherence to internal policies, audit standards, and applicable Brazilian and global regulatory requirements.
  • Identifying and promoting opportunities for the use of data analytics, automation, and AI to enhance audit coverage and efficiency.
  • Leads risk‑focused planning, fieldwork and reporting, in accordance with Internal Audit policies, methodologies, and standards to identify meaningful issues, risks and other exposures.
  • Responsible for ensuring testing is adequate and accurate to allow an evaluation of adherence to company policies and procedures, audit methodologies, and all applicable regulations.
  • Demonstrates skills and understanding of businesses and processes through flowcharting, work papers, analysis, issue identification and discussions with management and auditees.
  • Identify meaningful issues impacting business and operations under review, partnering with management to ensure appropriate remedial action has been taken to address the issues identified. Follow‑up of audit actions and test their implementation.
  • Applies advanced analytical problem‑solving skills and leads others in solving complex issues and identifying innovative solutions.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders across the Brazil businesses, second line functions, and global Internal Audit teams.
  • Apply knowledge of financial institutions and regulations daily, participate in relevant training, and share insights with the audit team.
  • Contributing to continuous risk assessment and monitoring activities, remaining alert to emerging risks and regulatory developments impacting the Brazil platform.
Qualifications
  • Demonstrated experience or hands‑on interest in applying data analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies to audit activities, including the ability to interpret and challenge analytics outputs to drive risk‑based insights.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience required.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.
  • Solid experience in Internal Audit or the relevant specialty area (Risk, Compliance, or Controls), with the ability to operate within a global audit framework.
  • Strong knowledge of the financial services industry, including preferably exposure to fund administration and/or custody activities.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) to engage in audits, reporting, and collaboration with international stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate issues and risks to stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
  • Additional skill requirements include understanding of the applied and interpretation of analytics results for Audit, critical thinking and problem solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively, and exercise professional judgment.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CIA, CPA, CFA) are preferred.
Benefits and Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay‑for‑performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

Awards

For over 230 years, the people of BNY Mellon have been at the forefront of finance, expanding the financial markets while supporting investors throughout the investment lifecycle. BNY Mellon can act as a single point of contact for clients looking to create, trade, hold, manage, service, distribute or restructure investments & safeguards nearly one‑fifth of the world’s financial assets. title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Missão do cargo:

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo:
  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;
Requisitos técnicos
  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);
Diferenciais desejáveis
  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.

Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

This role ensures the accuracy, compliance, and timely processing of personnel actions for faculty, staff, adjuncts, student employees, wage workers, and stipend-supported personnel. The incumbent functions as the College’s primary point of coordination between CEA leadership, HR, Payroll, the Office of the Provost, and departmental administrators. This is not an HR strategic role; instead, it is a senior-level operational and transactional position responsible for end‑to‑end workflow execution, Workday processing, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for supervising the Budget Coordinator, Administrative III. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and evaluates work performed. Makes merit and promotion recommendations to the Dean and ensures professional development alignment with institutional expectations.

Nature And Scope

The Senior People Operations Officer interacts daily with academic departments, program directors, faculty, HR Business Partners, the Budget Office, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost. The incumbent must exercise a high degree of accuracy and judgment in handling sensitive personnel information, navigating complex approval processes, and ensuring compliance with University policy, hiring standards, and audit expectations.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Serve as the College’s senior Workday transaction specialist for all hires, job changes, faculty terminations, PAPs, compensation changes, funding changes, and academic appointments.
  • Coordinate all job posting requests with HR Recruiting and ensure funding alignment prior to submission.
  • Draft and monitor term sheets, offer letters (where applicable), hiring packets, and background check requirements.
  • Manage onboarding workflows including I‑9, tax documentation, direct deposit, employee access, and new employee orientation tracking.
  • Initiate and track offboarding workflows for employees, adjunct faculty, and student workers.
  • Ensure accurate student hiring through FRFs, HAFs, wage-hire classifications, and Workday setup.
  • Maintain weekly hiring and transaction status reports for CEA leadership.
  • Conduct monthly HR and payroll compliance audits including cost allocations, active/inactive positions, and pending transactions.
  • Provide training and guidance to department administrators, chairs, and coordinators on Workday processes and personnel workflows.
  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for hiring, onboarding, terminations, PAPs, and Workday routing.
  • Liaise with HR, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost to resolve transactional issues and ensure timely processing.
  • Serve as subject‑matter expert for Workday HR and Workday Finance functionality relevant to personnel transactions.
  • Provide people‑data inputs to the Assistant Dean for reporting and planning (not financial analysis).
  • Manage confidential personnel information in accordance with University policies.
Core Competencies
  • Demonstrated ability to provide executive-level financial and operational guidance in a complex academic environment.
  • Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, accounting controls, and resource stewardship.
  • Ability to interpret policy, influence adoption, and lead change with diplomacy and clarity in evolving systems.
  • Ability to supervise, develop, mentor, and evaluate staff performance and ensure accountability.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex financial and operational issues clearly.
  • Skilled in Workday Financials, procurement systems, and advanced spreadsheet and reporting tools.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, or related field (required)
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience working in higher‑education operations.
  • Workday HR and Workday Finance familiarity.
  • Experience working with academic departments.
  • Administrative operations experience
  • Proficiency in Workday HR required.
  • Proficiency in Workday Finance preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and shared workflow systems.
  • Ability to run reports, analyze personnel data, and maintain accurate records.
